title: NEB Class 11 English — Language Development — 2022
origin: curated NEB-pattern set filling the 2022 gap for class-11 language development

questions.solution:
(a) Present simple passive — object becomes subject, verb becomes is/am/are + past participle: 'A letter is written by her.'
(b) Past simple passive — was/were + past participle: 'The students were praised by the teacher.'
questions.question: Change the voice: (a) 'She writes a letter.' (b) 'The teacher praised the students.'

questions.solution:
(a) 'He has been suffering FROM fever SINCE Monday.' — suffer takes 'from'; 'since' marks the starting point (Monday).
(b) 'She is good AT mathematics but weak IN English.' — 'good at' and 'weak in' are fixed adjective–preposition collocations.
questions.question: Fill in the blanks with suitable prepositions: (a) He has been suffering ___ fever ___ Monday. (b) She is good ___ mathematics but weak ___ English.

questions.solution: 'Had finished' is the past perfect — used for the earlier of two past events. The work was completed first, then the guests arrived (simple past). So the sentence is in the past perfect tense.
questions.question: Identify the tense: 'They had finished the work before the guests arrived.'
